spec.description: AS400Proxy application, JVM, timeout, user and application activity.

spec.title: FUN Timeouts on AS400
spec.description: Rate of timeouts for FUN (default is 10 minutes) - based on log occurrences

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", pod=~".*$as400proxy.*"} |~ "Session is not active: No response received from the queue" [5m]))

spec.title: Timeout Info
spec.description: Extra information extracted from timeout logs

spec.expr: {namespace="$namespace", pod=~".*$as400proxy.*"} |~ `Session is not active: No response received from the queue` | json fun="fun", session="sessionId", user="user", environment="environment", message="message"
sum by (user) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", pod=~".*$as400proxy.*"} |~ `Session is not active: No response received from the queue` | json user="user" [15m]))

spec.title: Garbage Collection Rate
spec.description: G1 Young Generation garbage collection rate over 10m

spec.title: JVM Loaded Classes
spec.description: Total Loaded Classes by the ClassLoader

spec.title: Total Live Threads
spec.description: Number of live Threads, both Daemon and non Daemon

spec.title: Live non-daemon Threads
spec.description: Number of live Threads, excluding daemon threads

spec.title: Thread Starting Rate
spec.description: Rate at which new application threads are created by the JVM

spec.title: Top 25 most active users
spec.description: Users launching the most FUN calls. V3 if the user is an email, V2 otherwise.

spec.expr: topk(25, sum by (unique_user) (count_over_time({container="$as400proxy", namespace="$namespace"} | json | fun != "" | fun !~ ".*LOGIN.*" | regexp "Application User:\\s*(?P<app_code>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)" | label_format version=`{{ if contains "@" .user }}V3{{ else }}V2{{ end }}` | label_format unique_user=`{{ if contains "@" .user }}{{ regexReplaceAll "@.*" .user "" }}{{ else if .user }}{{ .user }}{{ else }}{{ .app_code }}{{ end }}` | label_format unique_user="{{ lower .unique_user }}" | unique_user != "" | unique_user !~ "(?i)^($service_user)$" [$__range])))

spec.title: Logged in users - V2
spec.description: V2 logins in the selected time range (user without email).

spec.expr: sum by (unique_user, app_code) (count_over_time({container="$as400proxy", namespace="$namespace"} |= "Login for Server" | json | user !~ ".+@.+" | regexp "Application User:\\s*(?P<app_code>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)" | label_format unique_user=`{{ if .user }}{{ .user }}{{ else }}{{ .app_code }}{{ end }}` | label_format unique_user="{{ lower .unique_user }}" | unique_user != "" | unique_user !~ "(?i)^($service_user)$" [$__range]))

spec.title: FUN calls by user
spec.description: FUN calls per user in the selected time range, with V2/V3 version.

spec.expr: sum by (unique_user, version) (count_over_time({container="$as400proxy", namespace="$namespace"} | json | fun != "" | fun !~ ".*LOGIN.*" | regexp "Application User:\\s*(?P<app_code>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)" | label_format version=`{{ if contains "@" .user }}V3{{ else }}V2{{ end }}` | label_format unique_user=`{{ if contains "@" .user }}{{ regexReplaceAll "@.*" .user "" }}{{ else if .user }}{{ .user }}{{ else }}{{ .app_code }}{{ end }}` | label_format unique_user="{{ lower .unique_user }}" | unique_user != "" | unique_user !~ "(?i)^($service_user)$" [$__range]))

spec.title: Logged in users - V3
spec.description: V3 logins in the selected time range (user is an email).

spec.expr: sum by (unique_user, app_code) (count_over_time({container="$as400proxy", namespace="$namespace"} |= "Login for Server" | json | user =~ ".+@.+" | regexp "Application User:\\s*(?P<app_code>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)" | app_code != "" | label_format unique_user=`{{ regexReplaceAll "@.*" .user "" }}` | label_format unique_user="{{ lower .unique_user }}" | unique_user != "" | unique_user !~ "(?i)^($service_user)$" [$__range]))

spec.title: Top 10 applications by FUN calls
spec.description: Applications with the most logged FUN executions from the JSON app field.

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (application) (count_over_time({container="$as400proxy", namespace="$namespace"} | json application="app" | application!="" | fun!="" | fun!~".*LOGIN.*" [$__range])))

spec.title: AS400Proxy

spec.name: service_user
spec.label: Service user(s) to exclude
spec.description: Regex of service users excluded from user panels (full-name match, case-insensitive). Default: any user containing a digit. Combine with |, e.g. .*[0-9].*|svcuser. Leave empty to exclude nobody.
